links.outcome: Discharge-plan task coverage with vs without deterministic auditor-driven regeneration
links.effect: Self-improvement loop was the primary driver of gains, raising task coverage from 32% to 86%; context caching gave smaller gains over baseline.
links.quote: While context caching improved performance over baseline, the self-improvement loop was the primary driver of gains, increasing task coverage from 32% to 86%.

links.outcome: Calibration of LLM confidence estimates (Brier, ECE) and high-confidence misses
links.effect: Calibration improved substantially with the auditor loop, with reduced Brier/ECE and fewer high-confidence misses, implying miscalibrated confidence at baseline.
